label: Synth Pop
blueprintGuidance: Represent synth pop: electronic groove, clean hooks, bright melodic synth identity, and polished vocal production.
Keep the chorus direct and rhythmically clear.
Use mood input for neon, dreamy, lonely, futuristic, nostalgic, or night-drive color.
generationGuidance: Use electronic drums, pulsing synth bass, arpeggiated or plucked synths, soft pads, and polished lead vocal.
Keep the groove steady and the hook easy to loop.
Use vocal doubles or harmony only at hook emphasis points.
Make the ending cleanly cuttable for short-form use.
avoidGuidance: Avoid aggressive club drops, harsh supersaws, overloaded percussion, and muddy low-end.
Avoid acoustic folk or piano-ballad arrangement choices.
